meta.name: brand-guidelines
meta.description: Applies Anthropic's official brand colors and typography to any sort of artifact that may benefit from having Anthropic's look-and-feel. Use it when brand colors or style guidelines, visual formatting, or company design standards apply.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为作品添加品牌色彩与排版风格
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要为内容快速应用品牌视觉规范。
copy.tagline_en: Apply brand colors and typography to your artifacts.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly apply brand visual guidelines to your content.

howto.what: 按Anthropic官方视觉规范调整内容：标题用Poppins字体、正文用Lora，配色取自官方色板，非文字形状使用橙、蓝、绿强调色并循环。
howto.when: 当用户要求套用Anthropic品牌样式，涉及品牌颜色、视觉格式化或公司设计标准时触发。

say.text: 把这个PPT标题改成Poppins，正文用Lora字体。
say.note: Claude会按品牌字体规范处理。

say.text: 给我的图表配上Anthropic的官方品牌色。
say.note: 倾向于使用官方色板中的颜色。

say.text: 帮我把这份文档整体设计成Anthropic的风格。
say.note: 应用品牌字体、配色和强调色。

howto.what_en: Applies Anthropic's official visual spec: Poppins for headings, Lora for body text, color choices from the brand palette, and orange/blue/green accents cycled on non-text shapes.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to apply Anthropic brand styling or mentions brand colors, visual formatting, or company design standards.

say_en.text: Use Poppins for headings and Lora for body text in this deck.
say_en.note: Claude will set fonts per the brand spec.

say_en.text: Color these charts with Anthropic's official brand palette.
say_en.note: Colors follow the documented RGB values.

say_en.text: Restyle this document with Anthropic's look and feel.
say_en.note: Applies brand fonts, colors, and accents.
